key_phrases: strong demand for our industry-leading three- and five-nanometer technologies
analysis.reasoning: The earnings call reflects an extremely strong growth trajectory driven by AI and advanced nodes (N3/N5). Management provided highly specific quantitative guidance for Q3 revenue and gross margins. While CEO C.C. Wei was somewhat evasive regarding the exact timing of supply-demand rebalancing for CoWoS and specific pricing increases, his tone regarding technological leadership (N2, N16) and the structural nature of AI demand was exceptionally confident. Capex remains aggressive with a narrowed, high-end range to support growth.
